die_already.title: Would You Just Die Already
die_already.text: Defeat The Amalgam 5 or more times in The Pit of Despair.

elementary.title: Elementary, Dear Dawson
elementary.text: Guess both the correct [[Suspect]] and [[Hideout]] in The Vanishing of Elina Harper.

no_break_stride.title: Ain’t Nothin Gonna Break My Stride
no_break_stride.text: Destroy every barrier in In Too Deep.

speeding_ticket.title: Speeding Ticket
speeding_ticket.text: Reach Falcon Point Approach without voluntarily stopping any vehicles, getting out of any vehicles, or entering a copy of Long Way Around in Horror in High Gear.

locked_in_here.title: You’re Locked In Here With Me
locked_in_here.text: Complete A Light in the Fog without any investigators getting captured.

fish_out_of_water.title: Fish Out of Water
fish_out_of_water.text: Complete Into the Maelstrom with each investigator still wearing their Diving Suits.

dont_wake_daddy.title: Don’t Wake Daddy
dont_wake_daddy.text: Complete both The Lair of Dagon and Into the Maelstrom without waking Dagon or Hydra.

gone_fishing.title: Gone Fishing
gone_fishing.text: Defeat 20 [[Deep One]] enemies. Keep track with tally marks in your Campaign Log.

full_build.title: Full Build
full_build.text: Equip the Waveworn Idol, Awakened Mantle and Headdress of Y’ha-nthlei at the same time.

wake_up.title: “You Wake Up In A Room...”
wake_up.text: Recover each of the following memories throughout The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign:

items.two: A battle with a horrifying devil.
items.four: An encounter with a secret cult.

bigger_fish.title: Bigger Fish to Fry
bigger_fish.text: Complete The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign without defeating a single [[Deep One]] enemy.

line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

expertise.title: Innsmouth Expertise
expertise.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign on Expert difficulty.
